stage: development product diagnosis; W UMa, U Sge and RT Aur SAP outcomes already inspected
algorithm: Search SAP and PDCSAP independently with unchanged v3.0. Match epochs within each product; do not inject catalog periods.
Keep all originally selected real development cases, including unavailable inputs and contamination cases. No unknown-object discovery search.
Record disagreements; no automatic choice of the clearer product, no source confirmation.

Event diagnostic uses the data-derived SAP phase minimum and per-epoch SAP period; measure at P/2 and P with local side windows. Bootstrap adjacent even/odd depth differences descriptively, with no significance classification.
limitations: SAP and PDCSAP are derived from the same pixels. Agreement is not independent replication or source attribution.
Neither this diagnosis nor prior seen samples measure population accuracy.
Local baseline windows assume approximate linear baseline and may include stellar structure; depth comparison is not a complete binary model.
Short epochs retain original minimum-cycle requirements.
pre_evaluation_note: Corrected reference lookup for old manifest rows without explicit TIC before running; no inference rules changed.
